data.title: 冬马和纱 · 抽出的唱片
data.description: 唱片架前，她抽出一张唱片，侧过头仔细辨认封面上的名字。
data.action: holding a record sleeve and reading its cover
data.lighting: 私人音乐室复古留声机旁暖黄壁灯与落地窗外落雪
data.promptProse: Leaning back in a vintage leather club chair in her dimly lit music studio, Kazusa watches the spinning vinyl on a glowing turntable. Scattered sheet music, amber lamplight, and reflections on polished wood create a quiet, reflective atmosphere.
data.animaCaption: Warm amber lamplight softly touches Kazusa's slender fingers pulling a vinyl record from the shelf as snow falls outside.
